info.title: WhatsBoost Universal API
info.description: WhatsBoost lets you send SMS, WhatsApp, OTP, and USSD requests and manage related campaigns, contacts, devices, and account resources through the WhatsBoost REST API.

post.description: Sends bulk chat messages from WhatsBoost.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

account.description: WhatsApp account you want to use for sending. You can get the account unique ID from /get/wa.accounts or in the dashboard.

campaign.description: Name of the campaign, you will see this in the WhatsApp campaign manager.

recipients.description: List of phone numbers or group addresses separated by commas. Optional if 'groups' parameter is not empty. Accepts WhatsApp group address, E.164 formatted number, or locally formatted numbers using the country code from your profile settings.

groups.description: List of contact group IDs separated by commas. Optional if 'recipients' parameter is not empty. You can get group IDs from /get/groups (Your contact groups).

message.description: Message or caption you want to send. Spintax and shortcodes are supported.

media_file.description: For 'media' type messages only. The media file to attach to the WhatsApp message. Supports jpg, png, gif, mp4, mp3, and ogg files.

media_url.description: For 'media' type messages only. URL to the media file. Must be a direct link. Supports jpg, png, gif, mp4, mp3, and ogg files.

media_type.description: For 'media' type messages only. Required if using 'media_url' instead of 'media_file'. Declares the file type of the media in the provided URL.

document_file.description: For 'document' type messages only. The document file to attach to the WhatsApp message. Supports pdf, xml, xls, xlsx, doc, and docx files.

document_url.description: For 'document' type messages only. URL to the document file. Must be a direct link. Supports pdf, xml, xls, xlsx, doc, and docx files.

document_name.description: For 'document' type messages with 'document_url'. File name of the document. Include the file extension (e.g., document.pdf).

document_type.description: For 'document' type messages only. Required if using 'document_url' instead of 'document_file'. Declares the file type of the document in the provided URL.

shortener.description: Shortener ID. Specify the shortener to use for shortening links in your message. Get the list of available shorteners from /get/shorteners.

post.description: Sends bulk SMS messages from WhatsBoost.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

mode.description: Mode of sending the message, it can be 'devices' which will allow you to use your linked android devices or 'credits' which will allow you to use gateways and partner devices. 'credits' requires you to have enough credit balance to send messages.

campaign.description: Name of the campaign, you will see this in the SMS campaign manager.

numbers.description: List of phone numbers separated by commas. It can be optional if 'groups' parameter is not empty. It will accept E.164 formatted numbers or locally formatted numbers using the country code from your profile settings. E.164: +34612345678 Local: 612345678.

groups.description: List of contact group ID's separated by commas. It can be optional if 'numbers' parameter is not empty. You can get group ID's from /get/groups (Your contact groups).

message.description: Message you want to send, spintax and shortcodes are supported.

device.description: Linked device unique ID, this is required if you will send with 'devices' mode. You can get linked device unique ID from /get/devices (Your devices).

gateway.description: Partner device unique ID or gateway ID, this is required if you will send with 'credits' mode. You can get a partner device unique ID and gateway ID from /get/rates.

sim.description: SIM slot number you want to use. For 'devices' mode only.

priority.description: Priority level. 0 or 1 = high priority (sent immediately), 2 = normal priority (queued). For 'devices' mode only.

shortener.description: Shortener ID, specify the shortener you want to use if you want to shorten the links in your message. You can get the list of available shorteners from /get/shorteners.

post.description: Sends a one-time password from WhatsBoost.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

type.description: Type of message, it can be SMS or WhatsApp.

message.description: OTP message to send, you can use {{otp}} shortcode to include the OTP anywhere in the message.

phone.description:
Recipient mobile number, it will accept E.164 formatted numbers.
Example for Spain: E.164: +34612345678.

expire.description: OTP expiration time in seconds. Default value is 300 seconds or 5 minutes.

priority.description: For WhatsApp only. If you want to send the message as priority, it will be sent immediately. 1 for yes and 2 for no.

account.description: This is only for WhatsApp type. WhatsApp account you want to use for sending, you can get account unique IDs from /get/wa.accounts or in the dashboard.

mode.description: This is only required for SMS type. This is the mode of sending the message. 'devices' allows you to use linked Android devices, while 'credits' uses gateways and requires sufficient credit balance.

device.description: This is only for SMS type. Linked device unique ID, required for 'devices' mode. You can get linked device unique IDs from /get/devices (Your devices).

gateway.description: This is only for SMS type. Partner device unique ID or gateway ID, required for 'credits' mode. You can get partner device and gateway IDs from /get/rates.

sim.description: This is only for SMS type. SIM slot number you want to use, for 'devices' mode only.

document_type.description: For 'document' type messages only. Required if using 'document_url'. Specifies the file type of the document in the provided URL.

shortener.description: Shortener ID. Specify the shortener you want to use to shorten links in your message. Get the list of available shorteners from /get/shorteners.
